about: Site responses delayed: favorites in the sidebar while their cards are on the way, then loaded. A guest; the stars are put into the local list from the second page of the catalog, which the window has not shown yet.

steps.after: window.launcher.site.servers({ sort: 'online', page: 2, per_page: 50 }).then((list) => { const ids = list.ok ? list.value.data.slice(0, 4).map((row) => row.id) : []; localStorage.setItem('mcmonitor.favorites', JSON.stringify(ids)); return ids; })
